proposals.evidence: Turner separates section 4 *chaggala, with Bihari chāgar/chāgrī and Awadhi chagarī “goat”, from the contracted chēl branch. These selected Danuwar, Majhi and Tharu c(h)agar/cegar forms retain medial g and r and match that specific regional branch. Extra -iyā material is excluded; local borrowing remains unresolved by the comparative link.
